summary: Casanéo iteration 15 (4 fixes) tested backend + frontend with QA admin (qa.admin@casaneo.test). Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass — /api/auth/login (200 with correct creds, 401 with bad password), GET/PUT /api/properties persists default_cleaning_fee/default_tourist_tax, and promo season inserted at the head of property.seasons persists and remains first (correct primacy). Frontend: Login flow via 'Se connecter avec un email et un mot de passe' works. Calendrier: with 'Tous les logements' → hint 'Sélectionnez un logement…' visible and no prices; selecting a single logement (Cosy Cocoon) → 'Masquer les tarifs' active by default, price-<date> cells render prices in Réglette header and month-price-<date> cells render in Mois view. Tapping a price opens the 'Modifier le tarif' modal, edit + save via testID edit-price-save persists (verified prices switched from 95€ → 137€ after PUT). Toggle 'Tarif spécial (promo)' switches mode ('Annuler' label + promo hint). Property-form default fees (prop-default-cleaning / prop-default-tax) persist via PUT — reloaded form shows saved values 60 and 3. ISSUE FOUND: Réservation-form does NOT render cleaning-fee/tourist-tax fields for the QA admin user because canSeePrices() in /app/frontend/src/permissions.ts requires 'view_booking_amount' in permissions and does not bypass admin members — QA admin has member_role='admin' but permissions=[]. Consequence: the 'default fees pre-fill in a new reservation' cannot be verified via the UI for the admin QA account, and admins without explicit permission cannot see/edit prices when creating reservations. Pre-fill code path itself (reservation-form.tsx L129-130 & L168-169) is correct.

ui_bugs.issue: cleaning-fee & tourist-tax fields hidden for member with role=admin because canSeePrices() requires 'view_booking_amount' permission and has no admin bypass. Blocks verification & use of default-fees pre-fill for admin members.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/permissions.ts, update canSeePrices() to bypass admin members: `if (user.role === 'member' && memberRole(user) === 'admin') return true;` before the permission check. This aligns with canModify() and unblocks admins from seeing/editing reservation Tarifs (cleaning-fee, tourist-tax, nights-total) — required for the default-fees pre-fill to be observable/usable for QA admin.
Optionally seed 'view_booking_amount' into the QA admin member.permissions in Mongo as a workaround for testing until the bypass fix ships.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stays at 2944 lines — still an outlier; consider splitting the properties/reservations/members/notifications modules in a follow-up (already noted in iter14).
planning.tsx implementation is clean; special-price prepends to seasons list ensuring primacy — verified in test test_put_property_promo_season_persists_and_prime.

reservation-form.tsx pre-fill uses `p.default_cleaning_fee ? String(...) : f.cleaning_fee` which will keep the previous value if the property default is 0. That's a soft edge case (0 is falsy), consider `p.default_cleaning_fee != null` guard for future robustness.

success_rate.frontend: 5/6 flows verified (default-fees pre-fill blocked by canSeePrices bug for admin member)

To re-test the reservation-form pre-fill after the canSeePrices fix, replay the flow: (1) login as qa.admin@casaneo.test, (2) property-form for property d4b761bc-7fde-47a8-810f-92ff83a48973 → set prop-default-cleaning=60 & prop-default-tax=3 → save-property, (3) reservation-form?property=<pid> → assert testID cleaning-fee value == '60' and tourist-tax value == '3', (4) restore defaults to empty. rca_of_issue: canSeePrices(user) in /app/frontend/src/permissions.ts:144 gates the 'Tarifs' section render (reservation-form.tsx line 398). It returns true only for the Google owner (role !== 'member') OR members whose permissions array explicitly includes 'view_booking_amount'. QA admin member has member_role='admin' but permissions=[] (verified via GET /api/auth/me). Result: showPrices=false in reservation-form → cleaning-fee/tourist-tax inputs not rendered. Fix: add an admin bypass at the top of canSeePrices() consistent with canModify().
